title: Emotes and creator names / Animated grid

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Coordinate repetition and variation so a busy composition still gives viewers stable places to look.
strategic_value: Repeated creator names and emotes can turn Twitch community material into a recognizable graphic rhythm.
demonstration: A six-cell grid alternates repeated purple-and-white names with black cells where emotes multiply, move and change scale.
practical_value: Compare stable cell boundaries with changing content before increasing motion density.

content_islands.name: Name cells
content_islands.spec: Repeat AnneMunition, Kappa and Myth within alternating cells, allowing text to move and crop.

content_islands.name: Emote cells
content_islands.spec: Populate the black cells with changing arrangements and scales of face and illustrated emotes.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animation combines repeated creator names with multiplying emotes inside a stable grid.
